text: 江苏雷利：实际控制人、董事、总经理苏达于2026年11月4日收到中国证监会《立案告知书》，因涉嫌信息披露、减持违法违规被立案。本次立案调查仅为对苏达个人的调查，目前公司各项业务及经营管理情况正常，不会对公司董事会运作及公司日常经营活动产生重大影响。
text_en: Jiangsu Leili: Actual controller, director and general manager Su Da received the CSRC's Notice of Case Filing on November 4, 2026, and was placed under investigation for suspected violations of laws and regulations in information disclosure and share reduction. This case filing is an investigation of Su Da individually only; the company's businesses and operations are currently normal, and it will not have a major impact on the operation of the company's board of directors or the company's daily operations.
